name: cyberpunk80s-128
style_block: Top-down 2D game sprite for a retro-futuristic 1980s cyberpunk space vessel colony sim, RimWorld-like readability. Detailed flat-shaded 2D game art, crisp edges, slight 3/4 top-down view on raised objects, NOT photorealistic, no blur. Shared material family: matte gunmetal and graphite panels (cool near-black blue-greys), brushed chrome and dark anodized trim, neon accents in hot pink / magenta and electric cyan, deep violet shadows, small warm amber CRT screens, subtle 1980s synthwave mood. Avoid green surfaces and green lights entirely. Light source top-left, strong readable silhouette, subtle darker edge outline, consistent painterly flat shading. No text, no watermark, no drop shadow, object centered, plain solid background.

assets.name: anchor_floor
assets.prompt: Seamless repeating TEXTURE SWATCH, top-down orthographic, filling 100 percent of the canvas — this is a material sample, not an object: dark cold blue-violet gunmetal deck plating of a cyberpunk spacecraft (strictly cool indigo-grey steel, absolutely no green or teal tint), matte, subtle hairline panel seams, tiny recessed hex bolts at panel corners, one or two very faint thin magenta guide-light inlay lines along seams, gentle wear, very low contrast, completely uniform ambient light, no lamps, no vignette, no frame, no border. Edges must continue the pattern so it tiles perfectly in all directions.

assets.name: anchor_wall
assets.prompt: Seamless horizontally-repeating TEXTURE SWATCH filling 100 percent of the canvas — a material sample, not an object: heavy graphite hull wall panels of a cyberpunk spacecraft, one continuous horizontal neon magenta light strip glowing softly across the middle, thin chrome trim lines, darker and higher contrast than a deck floor, uniform light, no vignette, no frame, no border, no background.
